about: Which side of the road each country drives on, for the question "Which side of the road do they drive on in X?" (two options: Left, Right). `left` lists every country that drives on the left; all others drive on the right. The question is asked only where the answer is not obvious: every left-driving country except those under `obvious`; and a right-driving country only if it has a land border with a left-driving one or is listed under `alsoAsk` (right-driving places that sit among left-driving ones, or that a player might expect to drive on the left). Edit, then run `npm run derive`.
